summary: Portable conformance vectors for Invariant Probability Flow. Every implementation that claims this protocol version must produce exactly these outcomes.
procedure: For each vector, validate `input` against the protocol schema.
If `expect.valid` is false, the schema must reject the input. Do not resolve it. `expect.rule` names the violated rule for humans; error wording is not compared.
If `expect.valid` is true, the schema must accept the input.
SHA-256 of the canonical input (ipf-json-sorted-v1, receipts excluded) must equal `expect.canonicalInputSha256`.
Resolving the input at `evaluatedAt` must yield `expect.decision`, the same set of `authorizedEffectIds`, and the same blocked effects with the same set of blocker codes per effect.
provenance: Inputs are the reference demo protocol plus one named mutation each, recorded in `derivation`. Expected outcomes were taken from the founders-lab-os reference implementation. This file is the specification: change it deliberately, never by regenerating it from an implementation.
